headline: Jay Bharat Maruti opens window for physical share dematerialization
hook: Physical share transfer window opens for holders
summary: Jay Bharat Maruti has announced a special window for the transfer and dematerialization of physical shares. This process will be active from September 5, 2026, to October 4, 2026. Shareholders holding physical certificates must utilize this period to convert their holdings into electronic form. This is a procedural requirement for investors still holding legacy physical shares.
why_it_matters: Physical share holders must dematerialize to trade or transfer holdings.
